preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly 5 lines, each representing a blimp registration code.
Each registration code line has at most 11 characters, composed of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each character in a registration code is either an uppercase letter, a digit, or a dash.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'HE GOT AWAY!' if not any('FBI' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()) else stdout.strip() == ' '.join(sorted(str(i+1) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in line))
postconditions.description: If no registration code contains the substring 'FBI', output 'HE GOT AWAY!'. Otherwise, output a space-separated list of 1-based indices (sorted in increasing order) of lines where the registration code contains 'FBI'.
